file_reasoning: Cashier live product grid with theme resources, bestseller marker and offers.

resource_binding_reasoning.reasoning: VisibleProducts bound, CanEditOperation disables nested input, item click versus selection none. Dynamic sizing is delegated to codebehind; no claim of native fit from comments.

Marker has literal translucent white#F2FFFFFF but TextPrimaryBrush varies by theme. In dark theme light text on near-white can repeat UI002 conditional contrast issue; image underneath can vary. No screenshot proof.
Image overlays fallback in same104px band; HasImage only denotes URL presence, not completed decode. Name wraps3lines and price21px; card sizing must accommodate offers beneath.
Preparation route label and variant count presented separately; route badge says configured station rather than tested printer availability.
Nested offer button handles pointer Tapped only, no Click or Command. Parent base-product ItemClick must be suppressed by codebehind. Keyboard/automation activation is not established by markup.
Name star column and auto price avoid direct horizontal overlap. Fixed pale green pill and dark green text stay light palette while surrounding card is theme-aware.
Real retry plus loading/error/empty overlays; only spinner and grid loading inverses defined here. VM must prevent empty state competing with error. No demo records or financial writes in markup.
